_doc: Assumed economics for saas_premium — the links Power-of-1 cannot derive from the catalog. Every value is 'assumed' and carries its basis; replace with a measured figure when get_roi reports one.

retention_sensitivity_per_health_point.basis: assumed: subscription revenue; a 50-point health span (critical floor to healthy) is taken to move 12-month retention probability by ~20% of ARR, i.e. 0.4% of ARR per point

revenue_at_risk_share_by_band.basis: assumed: share of an account's ARR expected to be lost or contracted within the horizon, by health band; annual subscription renewals with 3-5% baseline churn in the healthy band
